name:
Lotus Biscoff Sandwich
                                Biscuits Vanilla | 110g
additional_desc:
The unique taste of Lotus Biscoff also comes in a sandwich Biscuit.
                                                    Two delicious crunchy Biscoff Biscuits with a smooth cream filling
                                                    in between. Enjoy the delicious caramelised taste of this filled
                                                    Biscuit wherever and whenever you want. Perfect for sharing with
                                                    your friends and family! Made with non-GMO ingredients, Lotus
                                                    Biscoff Biscuits are vegan friendly and contain no artificial
                                                    flavours or colors.A delicious, caramelised crunchy biscuit on
                                                        the outside, with a smooth creamy Vanilla filling on the inside.
                                                    
Comes in a handy sharing pack
No colours
No added flavours
Suitable for vegetarians.
ingredients: Wheat flour, sugar, vegetable oils (palm oil, canola oil), candy sugar syrup, raising agent (sodium bicarbonate), soy flour, salt, cinnamon, emulsifier (soy lecithin).
allergens: Contains Wheat, Soy, Gluten. May Be Present Milk
dietary: No Added Colours, No Artificial Flavours or Colours
storage_instructions: Keep in a cool and dry place, away from direct sunlight.
